page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number left; dateline block; division heading "LI." and title "Ad Civitates LEGATI EPISTOLA"; then one text column of running paragraph below. No margin notes.

main_text.p: ad Ecclesiæ suæ gloriam diutissime incolumem fervet. Bremæ VI. Aprilis 1584.
main_text.head: LI.
Ad Civitates LEGATI EPISTOLA.
main_text.p: CUm à Serenissimo Rege Navar-reno, ad Serenissimos Reges, Illustrissimos Principes & reliquos Ordines Imperii Religionem à superstitionibus Pontificis vindicatam am-plectentes, missus fueram, ut cum iis de rebus ad Ecclesiæ concordiam & amplificationem pertinentibus agerem, præsertim cum amplissimo Reip. Vestræ Senatu, neque tamen apud

page.notes: Dateline, heading and title partly blurred by stains; the Greek-looking display ornaments are not text. Words "Bremæ", "Aprilis" and "1584" read with some doubt in the dateline; the running head is set in italic and was read as "Epistola Henrici IV."
